newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares braked amid healthy trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares braked amid healthy trade.

text.p: Most share prices in the Estonian stock market eased on Monday as the official list turned over a healthy 51.3 million kroons, dealers said.
The index increased by 0.98 percent to 197.87.
"The balance between the buying and selling side seems to be have been reached and some investors probably took their profits," Sander Tanil, an analyst from Tallinna pank, said.
Market leader Hansapank traded most on the main list as it turned over 24.9 million kroons to close stable at 186 kroons.
Shares in Forekspank closed 3.85 kroons down at 138.90 on turnover of 8.2 million kroons.
Estonian Savings Bank was the only share in the main list that made gains and it closed 3.55 kroons up at 92 with shares worth 7.4 million kroons changing hands.
Union Bank lost 0.15 kroons to close at 45.05 on volume of 6.3 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market traded some 22.6 million kroons and Saku brewery and Norma plastic maker were the most active.
Saku turned over 7.4 million kroons to close 1.95 kroons down at 54.05 and Norma had volume of 7.3 million kroons. It closed 56.55 kroons versus 57.
